In nginx, the GeoIP macros are defined at the top of `src/http/modules/ngx_http_geoip_module.c`, and there are only three of them:

```c
#define NGX_GEOIP_COUNTRY_CODE   0
#define NGX_GEOIP_COUNTRY_CODE3  1
#define NGX_GEOIP_COUNTRY_NAME   2
```

These index the `GeoIP_country_*_by_ipnum*` function arrays in the country variable handler. The city variables (`$geoip_city_country_name`, etc.) are not driven by `NGX_GEOIP_CITY_*` constants at all — they pass byte offsets via `offsetof(GeoIPRecord, ...)` to `ngx_http_geoip_city_variable`, which reads `*(char **) ((char *) gr + data)`. So, to my knowledge, no macro named `NGX_GEOIP_CITY_COUNTRY_NAME` exists anywhere in the nginx source. Since I can't verify against the live tree and won't invent a number (a plausible-looking "3" would be a fabrication):

ANSWER: unknown
